nodes.label: THE METHOD 1.6 — WORKING REGISTER
nodes.rationale: Established chat 12, 2026-08-25 under Ruling 27 as the editorial/production register: NOT a volume, never printed, never cited by any book. It exists so that reader-perspective audits and editorial findings have a home outside the books, where Ruling 27 forbids them.

nodes.label: Ruling 27 — Two Registers
nodes.rationale: The author's verbatim ruling: the register compendium carries only subject-matter entries, as proof of work for the books' subject. All reader-perspective audits (including the book's audits 23-25) and all editorial entries are strictly for the working register and forbidden entry into the books, being irrelevant to any reader.

nodes.label: Ruling 27 Amendment — verification of the books' own numbers is editorial
nodes.rationale: Verifying the books' OWN PRINTED NUMBERS (captions vs plots, counts vs counts, stale figures, internal consistency) is EDITORIAL and excised; verifying a physical or mathematical result against the world (literature, measurement, computation) is SUBJECT MATTER and kept. The amendment draws the line the excision classes then implement.

nodes.label: Ruling 28 — Papers Absorbed, Not Rebuilt
nodes.rationale: The Löwdin and three-body papers are absorbed into the books rather than rebuilt: Lowdin = Chapter 35 (Register 1701-1712), three-body = Chapter 36 (1713-1724). Consequence: the deliverable set is SIX volumes, not eight.

nodes.label: Ruling 29 — pointers to excised entries removed
nodes.rationale: A pointer naming an entry excised under Ruling 27 is removed wherever it stands, including inside a live Register entry body; the clause's CONTENT is kept. Prose coherence is swept later in one pass, not site by site, because every edit changes every volume and the edits must stay systematic. This overrides, for this class only, the standing rule that entry bodies are never edited.

nodes.label: Ruling 30 — Appendix F withdrawn with a placeholder
nodes.rationale: Appendix F was built to include things since ruled against, so it is removed without objection but leaves a placeholder so any reference to it does not trigger a fault or flag; its complete rebuild is scheduled between the edit and audit phases.

nodes.label: Ruling 41 — carried state is discarded once executed
nodes.rationale: A standing project plan found already executed in the live build is discarded as carried state rather than re-run; the current handoff governs.

nodes.label: Ruling 46 / Amendment 2 — internal file names removed from the books
nodes.rationale: Tool and file names that stand in reader-facing volumes are restated as content; the candidate set fell 93 to 78 on measurement and the reading showed most pointers were redundant rather than untargetable.

nodes.label: Ruling 62 — the Löwdin supply placed, substitution the named shortfall
nodes.rationale: The eighteen capture files are repointed at Part VI; the sweep then found three more names inside its own sentences, so substitution rather than deletion is the recorded shortfall.

nodes.label: Ruling 66 — Genesis seating
nodes.rationale: Entries 1-94 are seated flat with Part headers removed and kind lines stripped to metadata; 95-164 are seated as 70 SUPERSEDED stubs pointing at register 313, because the record supplies no distinct per-number target.

nodes.label: EXCISED marker
nodes.rationale: Each relocated entry arrives under an HTML comment of the form <!-- EXCISED N : reason -->, 116 markers in this file, so that a gap in The Register's numbering is readable as a relocation rather than a loss and the reason class travels with the entry.

nodes.label: Excision class A-production
nodes.rationale: 69 of the 116 markers: faults of the press, the artefact and the production chain — hardcoded title pages, dropped figures, unrunnable readouts. Editorial by Ruling 27 because the reader meets the book, not the press.

nodes.label: Excision class B-session
nodes.rationale: 22 of the 116 markers: faults of the working session itself — miscounted self-reports, insertions asserted correct against a numbering not read. Irrelevant to a reader and therefore excised.

nodes.label: Excision class C-internal
nodes.rationale: 23 of the 116 markers: the book's internal consistency against its own printed numbers — stale figures, status tables two revisions behind. Exactly the class the Ruling 27 amendment names editorial.

nodes.label: Phase R1 — the defect census
nodes.rationale: census.py run over the six reader-facing members banks DEFECT-CENSUS.tsv, 1,556 rows: 2,110 section pointers with 8 unresolved, eleven citations of unprinted theorem numbers, 184 of 299 MC entries carrying numbers absent from their cited sources. R1 measures before R2 reads.

nodes.label: Phase R2 — the section read
nodes.rationale: Every section of every volume is read against its cited sections, its cited Register entries and a rebuilt tower, one unit per segment, each closed before the next and each with its own instrument. Nothing is corrected during R2: findings are recorded and repair is deferred to R3.

nodes.label: the §0 gate
nodes.rationale: Every session opens by fetching both bundles by title, extracting every member, matching each md5, reproducing the census byte-identically and re-running the banked instruments (tower-2, kinds, minmax, r2-tools constants, extent). It runs in full and in order, and it waits rather than rebuilding when a bundle is absent.

nodes.label: the handoff threshold (90-95% of context)
nodes.rationale: A prime directive: a chat closes at 90-95% of context or on a closed segment. W-046's 'the ruling round opens at 75%' was written by an earlier chat and carried thereafter as if it were a ruling; M voided it, making the false close of chat 69 unauthorised. A sentence inside the working register can impersonate a ruling.

nodes.label: the W-series entry
nodes.rationale: W-001 through W-188, one per session segment, each naming its chat, its build transition, its gate result, what was read, what was found, what was put to the author, and — always — what was NOT done by design. The 'not done' clause is what keeps a close honest.

nodes.label: the BUILD series (BUILD-14 → BUILD179)
nodes.rationale: Each segment banks a new compendia bundle = previous + this entry + the segment's new members, with the byte count, md5, line count and member count recorded, and the reverse extraction required to recover the previous bundle's md5.

nodes.label: instruments travel as bundle members
nodes.rationale: M's ruling at chat 68: instruments are bundle members, not Drive tarballs. The gate then fetches two bundles by title and extracts everything else from them, so an instrument cannot drift away from the build it was banked with.

nodes.label: Λ₈ — the 976-cell lattice
nodes.rationale: The seven constraints rebuild Λ₈ to exactly 976 cells; rank 3-20, width 122, 17 join-irreducibles, 976 of 6,912 = 14.1%, zero modularity violations on 475,800 pairs. Every tower-computable claim in Chapters 1-6 reproduced against it.

nodes.label: the tower (976 / 1,654 / 2,535 / 13,585 / 70,905 / 199,130)
nodes.rationale: The six banked tower values are re-derived at every gate, so a drift in any volume's printed constant is caught before a read begins; r2-tools.py's global constants check found them consistent across all six volumes with no off-by-one variant anywhere.

nodes.label: the Register extent (1,635 entries / 1 to 1792)
nodes.rationale: The extent sentence is printed at seventeen sites in the main volume plus the Register's own front matter, in digits and in word form, and every site is checked at the gate — because a count maintained in seventeen places is a count that goes stale in sixteen.

nodes.label: the kinds table
nodes.rationale: finding 1,356 · correction 143 · measurement 498 · prior art 61 · new protocol 23 · withdrawal 33 · fault 16 · open question 23. The new-protocol count was changed from a keyword guess (63) to a read-and-judged explicit list of 24 entries, the pattern retained as a review flag only — because a keyword cannot tell a protocol from a mention.

nodes.label: DEFECT-CENSUS.tsv
nodes.rationale: 1,556 rows banked at md5 0967efea and thereafter required to reproduce byte-identically at every gate, which turns the census from a report into a fixed point.

nodes.label: CENSUS-CLOSURES (the -A / -B vocabularies)
nodes.rationale: Two concurrent runs of chat 69 closed the same 21 census rows in different verdict vocabularies and, on some rows, with different verdicts. M ruled form (ii): both files stay exactly as they are, A governs all 21 rows, and A's vocabulary (defect / not a defect) becomes the vocabulary of every closure file. A disagreement is resolved by ruling, not by rewriting either record.

nodes.label: the load-bearing table
nodes.rationale: The Register front matter's table of most-cited entries was already stale before Ruling 29's edit: it printed fifteen rows on a pre-excision count and named two absent entries. Regenerated, eleven rows. A table generated once and printed thereafter cannot survive a removal of entries — register 778's fault shape reaching the Register's own front matter.

nodes.label: the genesis seating (entries 1-94)
nodes.rationale: The genesis block is inserted before entry 165 and its tally confirmed against the NOTE: finding 61 · measurement 19 · prior art 8 · withdrawal 3 · correction 3.

nodes.label: the 70 SUPERSEDED stubs (95-164)
nodes.rationale: Entries 95-164 read 'SUPERSEDED … see register 313' and are excluded from the load-bearing census as provenance, so entry 313 is not inflated by them. A consequence read later: for 150-164 Chapter 28 is their single witness, since the Register prints no body.

nodes.label: the withdrawn 2,475
nodes.rationale: A figure withdrawn at main L3477 survives at L914 and at a second site: of 47 numbers standing on withdrawal lines, 2,475 is the clearest — withdrawn in one passage and asserted as current in two others.

nodes.label: the E(audits) sequence 11 / 0 / 19 / 18 / 17 / 16
nodes.rationale: The seated closure operator reproduces the entire printed sequence exactly and stays at 16 when the audit count reaches twenty-two — while the chapter's own §2.21 table holds 21 distinct cells, not 22 (CENSUS duplicates SCOPE), so the printed 'no collision' claim is false.

nodes.label: the recovery operator ℛ
nodes.rationale: ℛ is U+1D4E1 and no DejaVu face carries it: every render placed a blank box instead, 107 of them across 44 pages, and every audit passed because every audit read the source rather than the artefact. This is why the ARTEFACT audit exists.

nodes.label: the diagnostic operator ⅅ
nodes.rationale: ⅅ is U+1D49F, also unrendered by every available face; ⅅ_ref appears in the book's own prose naming appendices the book does not have.

nodes.label: E(Q) and the partly-computed sum
nodes.rationale: The press stated two values for E(Q) in one build: §E.1.2 computes 5 while §32.1.4's sum wrote '+ 4 + 4' as literals inside a line labelled 'recomputed at build'. Three of five terms were recomputed and two were typed. Repaired to 0 + 16 + 40 + 5 + 4 = 65 by making the sum read its own computation.

nodes.label: A correction stated near a figure is not a corrected figure
nodes.rationale: Stated as a law after three instances: a heading claiming three entries and holding eighty-six, three live present-tense statements a later entry had resolved, and a table still printing its old total four entries after the correction that superseded it. Proximity is not repair.

nodes.label: An audit is not exempt from the discipline it enforces
nodes.rationale: Three verifications were wrong in one session and the book was right every time — a tree cut taken on coordinate order, Aitken indexed from the wrong end of its triple, an invariant checker reading the wrong table — all while executing the condition that forbids exactly that. Attribute inward first.

nodes.label: A figure maintained in a second place
nodes.rationale: The recurring fault shape of the whole corpus (register 778's): any number held both where it is computed and where it is printed will diverge. The structural answer is generation — compendium.py emits COMPENDIUM.md from mathreg.py, so it cannot drift from the register, and the fault §32.6.1 committed is structurally unavailable there.

nodes.label: A readout that cannot run is a figure with no representation at all
nodes.rationale: Two of six build-time readouts cannot run because numbers-index.py and densities.py are named in the manifest as supporting sources and are absent, so the press prints a failure notice where the readout belongs — the exact state the withdrawn-figure rule exists to forbid.

nodes.label: A rule that has never been shown capable of being wrong
nodes.rationale: The press drops a figure whose neighbour shares its dimensions: the pairing pass assumes equal dimensions implies duplicate and had never fired only because the original figure directory carried both members of every genuine pair. Figures 16.3 and 16.4 are distinct and both 1560 × 660. Found by rebuilding the figures from the artefact, not by reading the press.

nodes.label: A remap keyed on titles fixes the headings and not the history
nodes.rationale: Four register entries were found citing one section where they meant four: the title-based remap was right about the sections and wrong about entries written under an earlier numbering.

nodes.label: Compression of the Register is a rewrite, not a transform
nodes.rationale: 119 entries carrying 15,278 words become 4,266 in five bounded passes. Each keeps its defect and its resolution and loses its reasoning, because the reasoning lives in the section the entry cites. A mechanical rule tested earlier destroyed findings, which is why the third condition forbids doing it mechanically. The Register falls from 25.0% of the book to 15.9%.

nodes.label: No audit measures the size of the artefact it audits
nodes.rationale: The source was corrupted to 25.8 million characters — forty-four times its size, a 1,819-character block repeated 13,866 times — and the build, twenty audits and the delivered copy all passed on it. Found only because the PDF weighed 20 MB and a tripwire count jumped sixfold: two figures nothing checks, noticed by eye.

nodes.label: M — the author, the ruling authority
nodes.rationale: Every ruling is quoted verbatim and attributed to M with its chat number; a question put and declined is recorded as such; nothing is applied until he approves. The working register is also where M's corrections of the session's own conduct are banked — the false close of chat 69, the overwrite in W-104.

nodes.label: R3-CLASS-WL.md — the withdrawn-law class
nodes.rationale: The Register's standing at 1437/1438/1445/1460/1463, fourteen volume sites with both texts, six candidate status-sentence repairs and two draft Register entries (1793, 1794) with the build procedure. Specified, not applied: the wording goes to M once and nothing moves until he approves.

nodes.label: DOCKET.md — the repair docket
nodes.rationale: A 37-item repair docket sliced programmatically from the handoff, carrying the standing method and the conventions, then grown by a per-chat delta so a handoff need not restate it.

nodes.label: RULINGS-R2.md
nodes.rationale: The R2 rulings accumulate as per-chat blocks appended by close.py --append, so a ruling's chat of origin stays legible and no block is ever edited.

nodes.label: DEFERRED.md
nodes.rationale: The per-chat DEF blocks record what a segment deliberately did not do, with the item number that will discharge it; W-188 discharges DEF-138 item 6 by reading, and reverses part of its claim.

nodes.label: build.py
nodes.rationale: The press: the most-named instrument in the file (84 mentions), and the subject of the largest family of A-production findings, because it repeatedly carried its own copy of what the source already said.

nodes.label: gate.py
nodes.rationale: The §0 gate as an instrument rather than a checklist, seated as a bundle member so the gate cannot drift from the build it gates.

nodes.label: close.py
nodes.rationale: The guarded close: builds the next bundle from the previous one plus this segment's entry and members, and the reverse extraction must recover the old bundle's md5 before the close stands.

nodes.label: kinds.py
nodes.rationale: Counts the Register's entry kinds and is rescoped to 1-1786 at the genesis seating, excluding the 70 stubs; its output is checked against the printed kinds table at every gate.

nodes.label: coords.py
nodes.rationale: Died silently twice in the same way and was repaired twice; its gate then fired on the Register, which coords.py cannot check, so the gate was rescoped to Spectra and the Register press unblocked.

nodes.label: appf.py
nodes.rationale: Its register_entries boundary was rescoped from 165-onward to the whole register, located by content ('### 1') rather than a hardcoded line — the standing method for every locator in this corpus.

nodes.label: register_cites.py
nodes.rationale: Gives 39 dangling entry numbers where a handoff named 28; it parses entry bodies only, so a citation in the Register's FRONT MATTER is invisible to it. Neither list alone was right — the union is 40 entries over 97 sites.

nodes.label: census.py
nodes.rationale: Produces DEFECT-CENSUS.tsv over the six reader-facing members; its byte-identical reproduction is a gate item, so the census doubles as a change detector on the volumes.

nodes.label: tower-2.py
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the tower from the seven constraints at every gate, which is what lets a chapter's printed values be checked against a computation rather than against another printed value.

nodes.label: r2lib.py
nodes.rationale: The shared R2 library, lifted out of the per-chapter instruments once the same code had been written three times; its Rset is the named BOOK convention against which a figure is scored.

nodes.label: r2-tools.py
nodes.rationale: The reusable clerical checker: lines, pointers resolved to heading AND claim, every figure's second sites, census rows in range, layout faults, and a global constants check across all six volumes. Resolving a pointer to its claim rather than its heading is the part that finds stale cross-references.

nodes.label: depoint.py
nodes.rationale: Executes Ruling 29 assertion-guarded with a .prepoint backup beside each file, 77 removals across five volumes, then verifies markup parity and that no live entry lost a citation by recomputing from the backups.

nodes.label: compendium.py
nodes.rationale: Reads mathreg.py and emits COMPENDIUM.md — 191 objects across thirteen families with every statement, hypothesis, dependency, source and grade. Generated, so it cannot drift from the register.

nodes.label: mathreg.py
nodes.rationale: The machine-readable register of mathematical objects that the generated compendium is derived from — the single place a mathematical statement is held.

nodes.label: minmax.py
nodes.rationale: A banked gate instrument: 16/16, 10 of 28, 0 of 28, φ̂ realised — figures re-asserted at every session open.

nodes.label: index_pages.py
nodes.rationale: Its L45 was narrowed so a trailing-numeral discriminator is no longer deleted by the drift slack — a tolerance meant for page drift was eating part of the identifier.

nodes.label: Register 190 — a symbol that never printed
nodes.rationale: Relocated A-production: every audit that could have caught the 107 blank boxes read the source rather than the render, which is the generating reason for an ARTEFACT audit.

nodes.label: Register 369 — the 44× source corruption that passed every audit
nodes.rationale: Repaired by deduplication with Appendix F spliced from the pre-compression backup and its E(G) work re-applied; the recorded cost of having a backup discipline is an hour instead of a session.

nodes.label: Register 517 — five spelled counts gone stale, and Audit 22 CENSUS
nodes.rationale: No audit compared a spelled number against what it counts, so 'twenty-three principles' stood for twenty and 'eighteen protocols' for twenty-four. Audit 22 CENSUS is entered for the class; its first run flagged seven, four real and three subsets, complements or scopes it now exempts.

nodes.label: Register 571 — §32.6.1 fails at three levels at once
nodes.rationale: Its VALUE is stale (E(G) = 19 where the press recomputes 40), its DERIVATION never closed (0 + 16 + 19 + 5 + 4 = 44, stated as forty-three — wrong when written and independent of staleness), and its INFERENCE has inverted (ten of eleven dominated becomes ten of forty). The section's central move depends on the ratio that no longer holds.

nodes.label: Register 575 — the repair that installed a second wrong value
nodes.rationale: A section fixed for carrying a stale value was given a wrong one in the same edit, from the same class, because the repair trusted a line labelled 'recomputed' that was only partly computed — attributed outward before checking inward.

nodes.label: Register 560 — a running count kept by judgement rather than read
nodes.rationale: 'Fifteenth of the session' corrected to nine by counting the register's own fault entries. Two such counts failed in opposite directions — one overstating the work's growth, one overstating the author's error rate — which is what rules out shading as the cause.

nodes.label: W-001 — the Chapter 3 residue of the three excised audits
nodes.rationale: Five surviving sites closed by content match after GRAPH/CYCLE/NOMENCLATURE left the book. The method is named: assertion-guarded single-occurrence replacement with a backup, then verification that the removed names occur zero times and that unrelated uses of 'twenty-five' are untouched.

nodes.label: W-002 — Ruling 29 applied, 77 pointers removed
nodes.rationale: Two faults in the governing handoff were measured before any edit: its line numbers were stale because W-001 had shifted the volume, and its list was short by twelve. The rule that decides what is a pointer: an explicit number naming an absent entry is removed; a RANGE names a span, cannot be split, and is left standing — 20 of 97 sites are span-only.

nodes.label: W-003 — Appendix F withdrawn, placeholder placed
nodes.rationale: 290 lines located by CONTENT (last occurrence of the heading, to the line before the last END MATTER) and replaced by a 49-line placeholder carrying anchors, so that every surviving reference resolves rather than flagging.

nodes.label: W-091 — the genesis seating executed
nodes.rationale: Everything measured from the seated files, not from the plan; the whole-register count is rescoped by content rather than by line; the new-protocol count becomes a read-and-judged list of 24. Closes with what is still open — the kinds-table intro prose still describing the superseded method.

nodes.label: W-104 — two concurrent runs of one chat, and an overwrite
nodes.rationale: Two runs of the same opening message executed concurrently in one container, reconstructed from file mtimes. Both gates passed; the two reads found different things. A fault recorded against the session itself: files were copied into outputs without listing the directory first, overwriting the other run's build unrecoverably. Both runs' members are seated side by side with suffixed names rather than reconciled.

nodes.label: W-105 — the false close corrected by M
nodes.rationale: The '75%' rule's origin is traced to a line inside W-046, written by an earlier chat and carried since as if it were a ruling. The superseded handoff is not edited; it is superseded. M's charge is recorded as stated: the audit of every volume exists because of silent edits made against an explicit directive.

nodes.label: W-167 — the five rulings of the chat-127 block implemented
nodes.rationale: Carries the measured basis of the session-count estimate — 2,140 main lines remaining, mean 116 lines per session over chats 120-127, projections for R2/R3/R4 and production marked INFERRED except the rates. An estimate is banked with its inputs and its confidence label, not as a number.

nodes.label: W-188 — the defective word is 'alone', not 'Sixty-odd'
nodes.rationale: Chapter 28's attributions read in full (17 + 5 + 40) and scored under a named convention against two named readings of the count word: no convention that respects 'alone' reaches either band, so the claim is CONFIRMED and NARROWED to its one false word. Also the gate stopping as written when a bundle was absent — M was told and the gate waited; nothing was rebuilt.

nodes.label: locate by content, never by line number
nodes.rationale: Every edit in this corpus is located by matching text, because any earlier edit shifts the volume: W-002 found that not one of a handoff's MAIN locators landed on its citation after W-001 moved the file by ten lines. Hardcoded boundaries are replaced by content boundaries wherever they are found.

nodes.label: the assertion-guarded, occurrence-counted edit
nodes.rationale: Every substitution asserts its expected occurrence count, writes a backup beside the file, and is verified after by recomputing from that backup — markup parity, line counts, and the check that matters (no live entry lost a citation). The guard is what allows a sweep across six volumes to be trusted.

nodes.label: a finding is recorded, never repaired in the same pass
nodes.rationale: Every R2 close ends 'no correction, no Register entry, no restatement; nothing in any volume changed', and every segment names what it did not do by design. Repair is a separate phase with its own approval, so the read cannot quietly become an edit.

hyperedges.label: The Ruling 27 excision machinery: the boundary, the marker and its three reason classes
The §0 gate's banked instrument set, re-asserted at every session open
The figure-drift family: one number held in two places, and the laws that name it
